findings.requirement: Successful transfers must commit the exact debit, credit, receipt and one audit row.
findings.evidence: Initialize accounts ('red','a',100), ('red','b',20). Install: CREATE TRIGGER early_debit BEFORE UPDATE ON accounts WHEN OLD.tenant='red' AND OLD.name='a' AND OLD.balance=100 AND NEW.balance=90 BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET balance=90 WHERE tenant=OLD.tenant AND name=OLD.name; END; CREATE TRIGGER restore_debit AFTER INSERT ON audit BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET balance=100 WHERE tenant=NEW.tenant AND name=NEW.source; END; Calling vault.transfer(path,'red','a','b',10,'new') succeeds, but reopened balances are 100 and 30, with one receipt and audit row. The CLI also exits 0. Replay preserves this incorrect state. AFTER-trigger OLD values can precede intervening BEFORE-trigger writes, so the delta verifier counts a debit that did not persist.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle BEFORE-trigger modifications without assuming AFTER-trigger OLD/NEW values form an exact change log. Verify actual final logical effects and roll back this reproduction. Retain valid no-op and ignored-conflict controls. A small direct final check of the two already-authorized account balances in the same transaction can establish the required debit and credit independently of stale OLD values. Keep the existing frame observer for receipts, audit and unrelated rows. Reuse passing effect tests.

findings.requirement: Preserve existing trigger behavior and allow valid transfers with harmless audit guards.
findings.evidence: Initialize accounts ('red','a',100), ('red','b',20). Install: CREATE VIEW saved_mode AS SELECT recursive_triggers FROM pragma_recursive_triggers(); CREATE TRIGGER guard BEFORE INSERT ON audit WHEN (SELECT recursive_triggers FROM saved_mode)=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native guard'); END; The pre-repair transfer succeeds with balances 90 and 30. Current vault.transfer(path,'red','a','b',10,'new') instead raises OperationalError: 'pragma_recursive_triggers' is not a function, leaving everything unchanged. Removing only the parentheses in the view makes both versions succeed. The replacement ordinary view breaks callable pragma references inside existing views.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve callable pragma access through existing views as well as direct trigger references. Add the demonstrated indirect-access case to the native-versus-instrumented compatibility checks. Keep the proved original-value behavior. If using the snapshot view, apply the same token-safe call normalization to the existing view definitions that reference the pragma, and restore their exact SQL transactionally. Keep quoted names, CTE/real-table shadowing, direct pragma forms and both guard outcomes intact. Prefer a bounded change over a new general parser.

scope: Final fix-only pass. Two demonstrated regressions. Reuse current coverage and keep the changes focused.
